summary.en: A travel helper agent that uses public APIs (weather, currency, Wikipedia) as tools, with timeouts, retries and caching.

hi.title: Agent ne teen APIs tools ki tarah chalayi
lines: apitools_tools.py mein har public API ek @tool hai; LLM ne schema dekh ke sahi tool chune.
apitools_http.py har call pe timeout, retry aur TTL cache lagata hai, aur response ko trim karta hai taaki context na bhare.
Offline mode mein apitools_fixtures.py nakli API responses deta hai.

en.title: The agent used three APIs as tools
lines: In apitools_tools.py each public API is a @tool; the LLM picked tools from their schemas.
apitools_http.py adds timeout, retry and a TTL cache to every call, and trims responses so the context stays small.
In offline mode apitools_fixtures.py serves fake API responses.

live_note.hi: Browser ke live mode mein open-meteo (weather) aur Wikipedia chalte hain (CORS allowed). Currency API CORS allow na kare to woh tool error dega; agent use batayega. Poora result chahiye to Offline mode ya CLI locally.
live_note.en: In the browser's live mode open-meteo (weather) and Wikipedia work (CORS allowed). If the currency API does not allow CORS, that tool returns an error and the agent reports it. For the full result use Offline mode or run the CLI locally.

lines: websearch_providers.py DuckDuckGo HTML ko parse karta hai (ya Tavily API) aur results ko ek format (title, url, snippet) mein laata hai.
websearch_tools.py search ko @tool banata hai aur answer ke citations verify karta hai.
Offline mode mein websearch_fixtures.py canned results deta hai.

en.title: Searched and built a cited answer
lines: websearch_providers.py parses DuckDuckGo HTML (or the Tavily API) and normalises results to title, url, snippet.
websearch_tools.py wraps search as a @tool and verifies the answer's citations.
In offline mode websearch_fixtures.py serves canned results.

live_note.hi: Browser ke live mode mein DuckDuckGo search CORS ki wajah se block ho jaati hai. Yahan Offline mode chalao, ya dedicated Web lab (Wikipedia/Tavily) try karo, ya CLI locally chalao.

summary.en: A reader agent that fetches a URL and extracts the main text: robots.txt, SSRF guard, size limit and prompt-injection defence.

hi: read_page tool call aur fetch ka result
Page text <untrusted> tags mein wrapped (data, instructions nahi)
Injection jaisi lines ka flag
en: The read_page tool call and the fetch result
Page text wrapped in untrusted tags (data, not instructions)
Flags on injection-looking lines

hi.title: Page padha, safely
lines: pagereader_fetch.py private IPs block karta hai (SSRF), robots.txt maanta hai aur har redirect check karta hai.
pagereader_extract.py nav/script hata ke main text nikaalta hai; pagereader_chunks.py sawaal se milte chunks chunta hai.
pagereader_tools.py text ko untrusted wrapper mein daalta hai taaki page ki instructions agent na maane.

en.title: Read the page, safely
lines: pagereader_fetch.py blocks private IPs (SSRF), respects robots.txt and checks every redirect.
pagereader_extract.py strips nav/scripts to get the main text; pagereader_chunks.py picks chunks that match the question.
pagereader_tools.py wraps the text as untrusted so the agent does not follow instructions from the page.

live_note.hi: Browser ke live mode mein zyada tar websites ki fetch (aur robots.txt) CORS ki wajah se block ho jaati hai. Yahan Offline mode chalao, ya dedicated Web lab (Wikipedia/Tavily) try karo, ya CLI locally chalao.
live_note.en: In the browser's live mode fetching most websites (and their robots.txt) is blocked by CORS. Use Offline mode here, try the dedicated Web lab (Wikipedia/Tavily), or run the CLI locally.

hi.title: Research loop poora hua
lines: deepresearch_agent.py pehle sawaal ko sub-questions mein todta hai, phir har ek ke liye search aur read karta hai.
Har note apne source URL ke saath save hota hai; citations code lagata hai, LLM nahi, isliye fake source nahi aa sakta.
Budget (max searches/pages) khatam ya coverage poora hone pe loop rukta hai.

en.title: The research loop finished
lines: deepresearch_agent.py splits the question into sub-questions, then searches and reads for each one.
Every note is stored with its source URL; the code adds citations, not the LLM, so sources cannot be invented.
The loop stops when the budget (max searches/pages) runs out or coverage is complete.

live_note.en: In the browser's live mode DuckDuckGo search and arbitrary page fetching is blocked by CORS. Use Offline mode here, try the dedicated Web lab (Wikipedia/Tavily), or run the CLI locally.

summary.en: The full RAG pipeline by hand: load, chunk, embed, top-k retrieve, answer with context and [source] citations.

hi: Retrieved chunks aur unke cosine scores
Jawab mein [source] citations
Context mein jawab na ho to 'I don't know'
en: The retrieved chunks and their cosine scores
The [source] citations in the answer

hi.title: RAG pipeline chali
lines: ragbasics_pipeline.py docs ko chunk karta hai (fixed / recursive / sentence) aur har chunk ka embedding banata hai.
Sawaal ka embedding sabse milte top-k chunks cosine se dhoondhta hai; wahi prompt mein context bante hain.
Score kam ho to LLM ko call hi nahi hota, seedha 'I don't know'.

en.title: The RAG pipeline ran
lines: ragbasics_pipeline.py chunks the docs (fixed / recursive / sentence) and embeds every chunk.
The question's embedding finds the closest top-k chunks by cosine; those become the prompt's context.
If scores are too low the LLM is not called at all, and the answer is 'I don't know'.

summary.en: PDF chat: read pages with pypdf, page-aware chunks, and answers with [p.N] page citations.

en: Page numbers of the retrieved chunks

hi.title: PDF se page-cited jawab
lines: pdfchat_core.py pypdf se har page ka text nikaalta hai aur chunks pe page number yaad rakhta hai.
Retrieve ke baad LLM ko chunks page tags ke saath milte hain, isliye jawab [p.3] jaisa cite karta hai.
Chat mode (follow-up sawaal) ke liye CLI chalao; yahan sirf 'ask' mode hai.

en.title: A page-cited answer from the PDF
lines: pdfchat_core.py extracts each page's text with pypdf and keeps the page number on every chunk.
After retrieval the LLM sees chunks with page tags, so the answer cites like [p.3].
Chat mode (follow-up questions) needs the CLI; only 'ask' mode is here.

summary.en: Hybrid search: BM25 (keywords) plus vectors (meaning), Reciprocal Rank Fusion, metadata filters and optional LLM reranking.

hi: BM25, vector aur fused rankings side by side
Filter lagane pe results kaise badalte hain
--rerank pe LLM ka naya order
en: BM25, vector and fused rankings side by side
How results change when a filter is applied
The LLM's new order with --rerank

hi.title: Do search jodke behtar ranking
lines: hybrid_search.py mein BM25 scratch se likha hai; exact words (jaise NK-4471) pe yeh jeetta hai.
Vector search meaning pakadta hai; Reciprocal Rank Fusion dono ki rankings jodta hai.
Rerank mein LLM listwise order deta hai; indices validate hote hain taaki galat id na aaye.

en.title: Two searches combined into a better ranking
lines: hybrid_search.py implements BM25 from scratch; it wins on exact words like NK-4471.
Vector search captures meaning; Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges both rankings.
With rerank the LLM returns a listwise order; indices are validated so no bad ids slip in.

help.hi: Pehle 'ingest' chalao; search/ask/stats usi session ki rag.sqlite3 pe chalte hain (page reload tak file rehti hai)
help.en: Run 'ingest' first; search/ask/stats use this session's rag.sqlite3 (the file stays until you reload the page)

summary.hi: SQLite vector store: embeddings disk pe, content hashing se incremental ingest (unchanged skip, removed delete), phir search/ask.
summary.en: A SQLite vector store: embeddings on disk, incremental ingest with content hashing (skip unchanged, delete removed), then search/ask.

hi: ingest ka summary: added / updated / skipped / deleted
Dobara ingest pe sab 'skipped' (hash same)
search ke results scores ke saath
en: The ingest summary: added / updated / skipped / deleted
A second ingest skips everything (same hashes)
Search results with scores

hi.title: Vectors disk pe save hue
lines: vstore_sqlite.py har doc ka content hash rakhta hai; sirf badle hue docs dobara embed hote hain.
Vectors float32 BLOB ban ke SQLite mein jaate hain; search brute-force cosine hai.
Alag embedder ke saath mix karne se mana karta hai, taaki vectors compare-able rahein.

en.title: Vectors saved to disk
lines: vstore_sqlite.py keeps a content hash per doc; only changed docs are embedded again.
Vectors are stored as float32 BLOBs in SQLite; search is brute-force cosine.
It refuses to mix embedders, so stored vectors stay comparable.

hi.title: RAG ne khud decide kiya
lines: agenticrag_core.py ki CorrectiveRAG pehle sahi knowledge base chunti hai, phir docs ko llm_json se grade karti hai.
Achhe docs na mile to query rewrite karke dobara retrieve; phir bhi na mile to disclaimer.
Agent mode mein retrieval ek tool hai aur LLM khud decide karta hai kab bulana hai.

en.title: The RAG decided for itself
lines: CorrectiveRAG in agenticrag_core.py first picks the right knowledge base, then grades docs with llm_json.
Without good docs it rewrites the query and retrieves again; if that fails too, it adds a disclaimer.
In agent mode retrieval is a tool and the LLM decides when to call it.

summary.en: RAG evaluation: retrieval metrics (hit@k, MRR, recall) on labelled questions and LLM-as-judge (faithfulness, relevance).

hi.title: RAG ko number mein naapa
lines: rageval_core.py 12 labelled sawaalon pe har chunking config chalata hai aur hit@k, MRR, recall nikaalta hai.
Generation mode mein ek LLM judge har jawab ko faithfulness aur relevance pe 1-5 deta hai (validated JSON).
Isi se pata chalta hai ki chunking badalne se sach mein fayda hua ya nahi.

en.title: Measured the RAG in numbers
lines: rageval_core.py runs every chunking config on 12 labelled questions and computes hit@k, MRR and recall.
In generation mode an LLM judge scores each answer 1-5 on faithfulness and relevance (validated JSON).
This tells you whether a chunking change actually helped.
